airspace.zh: 清水斷崖位於太魯閣國家公園內。依〈太魯閣國家公園區域內禁止事項〉第6點，未經許可不得在指定地區以外操作遙控機具（包含無人機），違者罰鍰新臺幣1,500元、再犯3,000元；實際飛行須先取得太魯閣國家公園管理處同意，並遵守民航局規定（日間、400呎以下，飛行前查詢空域圖資）。
airspace.en: Qingshui Cliff lies inside Taroko National Park. Item 6 of the park's Prohibited Acts bans operating remote-controlled craft (drones included) outside designated areas without authorisation, with fines of NT$1,500, or NT$3,000 for repeat offences; get the park headquarters' consent first and follow CAA rules (daytime, below 400 ft, check the airspace map before flying).

heren_station.note: 北迴線三等站，斷崖北端的和仁聚落（和平村）

chongde_station.note: 北迴線三等站，斷崖南端的崇德聚落

liwu_mouth.note: 立霧溪在崇德南側注入太平洋的河口

title.zh-Hant: 崖上的路：從北路到蘇花改
title.en: The Road on the Cliff: From the Northern Road to the Suhua Improvement

tagline.zh-Hant: 一百五十年來，人怎麼通過這面山壁
tagline.en: A century and a half of getting past one wall of rock

zh: 從崇德往北看，山壁一路擋到海邊。
人是怎麼在這面崖上開出路來的？
en: Seen from Chongde, the mountain wall runs right down to the sea.
How did people open a road across this cliff?

zh: 1874年牡丹社事件後，沈葆楨下令開路。
羅大春率隊開闢蘇澳到花蓮的「北路」。
en: In 1874, after the Mudan Incident, Shen Baozhen ordered a road built.
Luo Dachun led the work on the Northern Road from Su'ao to Hualien.

zh: 北路約兩年完成，但路基狹窄，
到清末大多已經荒廢。
en: The Northern Road took about two years, but its bed was narrow,
and by the late Qing most of it lay abandoned.

zh: 1916年，臺灣總督府開始修築東海徒步道，
七年後完成，但車輛仍無法通行。
en: In 1916 the Government-General began building the Donghai Footpath;
it was finished seven years later, still impassable to vehicles.

zh: 拓寬之後，1932年5月以「臨海道路」通車。
全線約120公里，九座大橋、十四座隧道。
en: After widening, it opened to vehicles in May 1932 as the Coastal Road:
about 120 km, with nine large bridges and fourteen tunnels.

zh: 戰後改稱蘇花公路。
最窄處僅3.5公尺，長期採單向管制通行。
en: After the war it was renamed the Suhua Highway.
Only 3.5 m wide at its narrowest, it long ran as controlled one-way traffic.

zh: 1980年代開始拓寬，
1990年10月25日改為雙向通車。
en: Widening began in the 1980s,
and two-way traffic started on 25 October 1990.

zh: 公路改走隧道。匯德隧道長1500公尺，
是蘇花公路上最長的一座。
en: The road moved into tunnels. Huide Tunnel, 1,500 m long,
is the longest on the Suhua Highway.

zh: 南端的崇德隧道長325公尺；
舊的清水隧道則已經封閉。
en: Chongde Tunnel, at the southern end, is 325 m long;
the old Qingshui road tunnel has been closed.

zh: 隧道通車後，一段舊路改成匯德步道。
石欄杆用的是開鑿隧道挖出的石材。
en: Once the tunnel opened, a stretch of old road became the Huide Trail.
Its stone railings were built from rock excavated for the tunnel.

zh: 北迴鐵路在1973年動工。
和仁站在1979年2月8日啟用。
en: Work on the North-Link railway began in 1973.
Heren Station opened on 8 February 1979.

zh: 和仁與崇德之間，火車走清水隧道。
第一代隧道長2106公尺。
en: Between Heren and Chongde the trains run through the Qingshui Tunnel.
The first-generation bore is 2,106 m long.

zh: 北迴線在1980年2月1日全線通車，
全長79.2公里，共有91座隧道。
en: The whole North-Link line opened on 1 February 1980:
79.2 km of track, with 91 tunnels.

zh: 鐵路通車以後，東部與北部之間的往來，
不再只依賴這條公路。
en: With the railway open, travel between the east and the north
no longer depended on this highway alone.

zh: 新清水隧道長2210公尺，約2001年通車。
和仁到崇德的雙軌在2002年完成。
en: A new 2,210 m Qingshui Tunnel opened around 2001,
and the double track from Heren to Chongde was completed in 2002.

zh: 2020年1月6日，蘇花改和中到大清水段通車，
這一段的車流改走新隧道。
en: On 6 January 2020 the Hezhong–Daqingshui section of the Suhua Improvement opened,
moving through traffic here into new tunnels.

zh: 1937年，日本時代曾設立次高太魯閣國立公園。
1986年，太魯閣國家公園成立。
en: In 1937, under Japanese rule, the Tsugitaka-Taroko National Park was created.
The present Taroko National Park was established in 1986.

zh: 步道、車道、鐵道與新隧道，
都是不同年代面對同一面山壁的答案。
en: Footpath, motor road, railway and new tunnels:
each era's answer to the same wall of rock.

title.zh-Hant: 崖腳下的聚落：崇德與和仁
title.en: Settlements Below the Cliff: Chongde and Heren

tagline.zh-Hant: 沖積扇、礫灘與兩座小站上的生活
tagline.en: Life on an alluvial fan, a gravel shore and two small stations

zh: 斷崖南端的崇德，是一片臨海的平地。
誰住在這面山壁的腳下？
en: Chongde, at the southern end of the cliff, is a flat shelf beside the sea.
Who lives at the foot of this wall?

zh: 這裡屬於花蓮縣秀林鄉，
面積約1642平方公里，是全臺最大的鄉。
en: This is Xiulin Township, Hualien County:
about 1,642 square kilometres, the largest township in Taiwan.

zh: 全鄉約一萬七千人，
多數居民是太魯閣族。
en: The township has about 17,000 people,
and most residents are Truku.

zh: 太魯閣族的祖先原居濁水溪上游，
越過奇萊山，東遷到立霧溪流域。
en: Truku ancestors lived on the upper Zhuoshui River,
then crossed Mount Qilai and moved east into the Liwu valley.

zh: 2004年，太魯閣族獲政府正式認定，
成為臺灣第十二個原住民族。
en: In 2004 the Truku were formally recognised
as Taiwan's twelfth Indigenous people.

zh: 立霧溪口北岸最高的階地上，有崇德遺址。
年代約在1500到900年前。
en: On the highest terrace north of the Liwu River mouth lies the Chongde Site,
dated to roughly 1,500 to 900 years ago.

zh: 2016到2019年間，考古學者多次在此發掘，
出土墓葬與陶器，屬於十三行文化。
en: Archaeologists dug here several times between 2016 and 2019,
finding burials and pottery of the Shisanhang culture.

zh: 聚落外就是礫石海灘。
崇德外海設有定置漁網。
en: Beyond the village lies a gravel beach.
Set nets are anchored in the sea off Chongde.

zh: 定置網是日治時期引進的漁法：
用一道垣網，把洄游的魚群引進網內。
en: The set net is a fishing method introduced in the Japanese era:
a long leader net guides migrating fish into the trap.

zh: 花蓮港離這裡較遠，
漁獲常用膠筏直接運上岸。
en: Hualien Port is some distance away,
so the catch is often brought straight ashore by raft.

zh: 崇德車站在1979年2月8日啟用，
是只有區間列車停靠的三等站。
en: Chongde Station opened on 8 February 1979,
a third-class stop served only by local trains.

zh: 2023年，平均每天約49人進出。
en: In 2023 it handled about 49 passengers a day.

zh: 往北進入斷崖。南段舊稱得其黎斷崖，
中段的清水斷崖，舊稱石硿仔斷崖。
en: Northward the cliff begins. The southern part was once called Deqili Cliff;
the middle part, Qingshui Cliff, was known as Shikongzi Cliff.

zh: 國家公園在這段海岸設有三處遊憩區：
和仁、匯德與崇德。
en: The national park keeps three recreation areas on this coast:
Heren, Huide and Chongde.

zh: 崇德步道長約320公尺，
走十分鐘左右就能下到礫灘。
en: The Chongde Trail is about 320 m long;
roughly ten minutes on foot leads down to the gravel beach.

zh: 北段舊稱卡那崗斷崖，
盡頭就是和仁。
en: The northern part was once called Kanagang Cliff;
at its far end lies Heren.

zh: 和仁車站位在和平村，同樣在1979年啟用，
2023年每天約85人進出。
en: Heren Station, in Heping Village, also opened in 1979;
in 2023 it saw about 85 passengers a day.

zh: 再往北是和平，設有水泥專用港。
en: Farther north is Heping, with its dedicated cement port.

zh: 斷崖讓聚落只能落腳在南北兩端，
公路、鐵路與海，把它們連在一起。
en: The cliff leaves room for settlement only at its two ends;
road, railway and sea tie them together.

title.zh-Hant: 從海面到稜線：斷崖的生態界線
title.en: From Sea to Ridge: The Cliff as an Ecological Boundary

tagline.zh-Hant: 陡坡、山壁與溪流如何分隔生物
tagline.en: How steep slopes, a rock wall and a river sort living things

zh: 秋天早晨的清水斷崖。
灰白的岩壁之間，是成片的深綠。
en: Qingshui Cliff on an autumn morning.
Between pale rock faces lie broad patches of deep green.

zh: 從海面到2408公尺的清水山頂，
這麼陡的山，生物怎麼分布？
en: From the sea to the 2,408 m summit of Qingshui Mountain:
on a slope this steep, how does life arrange itself?

zh: 太魯閣國家公園的植被隨海拔改變：
闊葉林、針闊葉混合林，再到針葉林。
en: Vegetation in Taroko National Park changes with elevation:
broadleaf forest, then mixed forest, then conifers.

zh: 園區最高處，則是高山草原與寒原。
en: At the park's highest levels come alpine grassland and tundra.

zh: 靠山的一側是茂密的闊葉林，
臨海的崖壁上長著山芙蓉、山鹽青等灌木。
en: The landward side carries dense broadleaf forest;
on the seaward cliffs grow shrubs such as Taiwan cotton rose and sumac.

zh: 山芙蓉在秋天開花，
為崖邊的灌叢添上花色。
en: The cotton rose flowers in autumn,
adding colour to the scrub along the cliff edge.

zh: 斷崖被劃為特別景觀區，
後方的清水山則屬於生態保護區。
en: The cliff is zoned as a Special Landscape Area;
Qingshui Mountain behind it lies in an Ecological Protection Area.

zh: 進入生態保護區必須事先申請許可。
清水山路線約50公里，建議行程四天。
en: Entering the protection area requires a permit in advance.
The Qingshui Mountain route is about 50 km, a suggested four days.

zh: 對一些動物來說，斷崖是擴散的屏障。
褐樹蛙的東、西兩個支系就以這裡為界。
en: For some animals the cliff is a barrier to dispersal.
The eastern and western clades of the brown tree frog divide here.

zh: 再往南，立霧溪也是一條分界。
兩種近緣的草蜥分居溪的兩側。
en: Farther south, the Liwu River is another dividing line:
two sibling species of grass lizard live on either side.

zh: 牠們是翠斑草蜥與鹿野草蜥，
研究指出兩者以這條溪為界。
en: They are Takydromus viridipunctatus and T. luyeanus;
research places the boundary between them at this river.

zh: 溪水在這裡流進太平洋，
淡水與海水在河口交會。
en: Here the river runs into the Pacific,
and fresh water meets salt water at the mouth.

zh: 崇德的礫灘上，常見白色的大理岩卵石，
和山壁上的大理岩是同一種岩石。
en: White marble pebbles are common on the gravel beach at Chongde,
the same rock as the marble in the cliffs.

zh: 外海是洄游魚類經過的水域。
花蓮定置網的漁獲以鰹魚類最多。
en: Offshore is a passage for migratory fish.
Bonitos make up most of the catch in Hualien's set nets.

zh: 夏季還常見鬼頭刀與曼波魚。
en: In summer, mahi-mahi and ocean sunfish are also common.

zh: 2026年3月，崇德定置網內發現鬚鯨遺體，
體長15.4公尺，初判為長須鯨或大村鯨。
en: In March 2026 a dead baleen whale, 15.4 m long, was found in the Chongde set net,
first assessed as a fin whale or an Omura's whale.

zh: 國家公園內禁止採集標本與設置陷阱，
也不能擅自操作遙控機具。
en: Inside the national park, collecting specimens and trapping are prohibited,
as is operating remote-controlled craft without permission.

zh: 陡坡分出植被，山壁與溪流隔開族群。
這面斷崖，同時也是一條生態的界線。
en: Steep slopes sort the vegetation; rock wall and river divide populations.
The cliff is at once a landmark and an ecological boundary.

title.zh-Hant: 山直入海：清水斷崖的地形與岩石
title.en: Mountain into Sea: Landform and Rock of Qingshui Cliff

tagline.zh-Hant: 二十公里的海崖是怎麼站起來的
tagline.en: How twenty kilometres of sea cliff came to stand

zh: 花蓮縣秀林鄉，蘇花公路經過的海岸。
山壁從太平洋邊直接拔起。
en: Xiulin Township, Hualien: the coast followed by the Suhua Highway.
The mountain wall rises straight from the edge of the Pacific.

zh: 這一段海崖，就是清水斷崖。
它為什麼這麼高、這麼陡？
en: This stretch of sea cliff is Qingshui Cliff.
Why is it so high, and so steep?

zh: 依觀光署的說明，崇德到和平之間
約20公里的路段，都屬於清水斷崖。
en: By the Tourism Administration's account, about 20 km of road
between Chongde and Heping counts as Qingshui Cliff.

zh: 崖壁高達千餘公尺，
公路只是山腰上的一條細線。
en: The walls stand more than a thousand metres high;
the highway is a thin line cut into the slope.

zh: 崖頂後方的清水山，海拔2408公尺，
是這片海崖的最高點。
en: Qingshui Mountain, behind the cliff top, reaches 2,408 m,
the highest point of this sea cliff.

zh: 稜線向南延伸到千里眼山與立霧山，
海拔分別是1624與1274公尺。
en: The ridge runs south to Qianliyan and Liwu mountains,

zh: 岩壁主要由大理岩與片麻岩構成，
北段還有綠色片岩。
en: The wall is built mainly of marble and gneiss,
with green schist in the northern part.

zh: 大理岩原本是石灰岩，經變質作用而成。
這套岩層的厚度估計有1500到2000公尺。
en: The marble began as limestone and was later metamorphosed.
The formation is estimated to be 1,500 to 2,000 m thick.

zh: 這條大理岩帶從和平沿著海岸，
經清水山一路延伸進太魯閣峽谷。
en: The marble belt runs from Heping along this coast,
through Qingshui Mountain and on into Taroko Gorge.

zh: 這裡位在歐亞板塊的邊緣，
受菲律賓海板塊碰撞，每年仍抬升約0.5公分。
en: This is the edge of the Eurasian Plate, in collision with the Philippine Sea Plate;
the land is still rising about 0.5 cm a year.

zh: 從正上方看，海水常分成兩種顏色：
外海深藍，近岸粉白。
en: From directly above, the sea often shows two colours:
deep blue offshore, milky pale near the shore.

zh: 兩種顏色之間，有一條清楚的界線。
en: Between the two colours runs a sharp boundary line.

zh: 往南，山壁在崇德退開，
眼前出現一片平坦的沖積扇。
en: To the south the wall steps back at Chongde,
and a flat alluvial fan opens ahead.

zh: 崇德的房舍與鐵路都在這片扇面上，
背後是斷崖的南端。
en: Chongde's houses and railway sit on this fan,
with the southern end of the cliff behind them.

zh: 立霧溪發源於合歡山與奇萊北峰一帶，
蜿蜒約58公里後在這裡入海。
en: The Liwu River rises near Hehuanshan and Qilai North Peak,
and winds about 58 km before reaching the sea here.

zh: 上游就是太魯閣峽谷，
同一套大理岩在那裡被溪水切開。
en: Upstream lies Taroko Gorge,
where the river has cut down through the same marble.

zh: 太魯閣國家公園從這片海岸起算，
最高到南湖大山的3742公尺。
en: Taroko National Park begins at this shoreline
and climbs to 3,742 m on Nanhu Mountain.

zh: 大理岩與片麻岩構成的山體仍在抬升，
山與海之間，幾乎沒有平地。
en: A mountain of marble and gneiss, still being lifted,
leaves almost no flat ground between ridge and sea.
